name: CPRet
description: CPRet is a retrieval-oriented benchmark suite for competitive programming, covering four retrieval tasks including Text-to-Code, Code-to-Code, Problem-to-Duplicate, and Simplified-to-Full. It provides high-quality training data and temporally separated test sets to evaluate retrieval models in competitive programming contexts.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark for retrieval in competitive programming, with growing interest in code-retrieval research but limited broad community adoption so far.
notes: Highlights the impact of problem similarity on evaluation; open-sourced retrievers trained on this dataset.
